context_in: TEMPUS NATIVITATIS › I. Usque ad sollemnitatem Epiphaniae › AD OFFICIUM LECTIONIS › rubric 'In sollemnitate' › hymn Candor aeternae Deitatis (H.I) begun at foot of p19.
context_out: TEMPUS NATIVITATIS › I. Usque ad sollemnitatem Epiphaniae › AD OFFICIUM LECTIONIS › hymn Candor aeternae Deitatis (H.I) runs through stanza 4 at foot of p20 and ends on p21 (stanza 5, Amen). Then on p21 the rubric 'Alter tonus ad libitum pro diebus infra octavam' introduces a second melody (H.IV) of Candor aeternae, begun p21 (belongs to p21's producer).
flags: Page holds only stanzas 1-4 (middle) of Candor aeternae Deitatis H.I; stanza 5 and Amen are on top of p21.
p21 prints 'Alter tonus ad libitum pro diebus infra octavam' with a full H.IV engraving of Candor aeternae; it begins on p21, so is not assigned here.
